content: Shilǝn ki Istipanus akina ɗǝ mi'dlǝl shilǝn
I bal lǝɓa ki Lya ngem Istipanas, “Gu nǝgu ɗaya?”
Istipanas usu: “Yelsǝni ini nǝ mi'kina, gaki nǝn kǝm. Lya mul nalti i' mbǝlgawasi ma' mul zǝmini Iblahim, age muttu nǝ ti a Bagadaza u, bǝ ta dǝm a Halan uwai,
i' Lya ultisu, ‘Hilya ɗǝ ge' atlwakǝn, nǝ ɗǝge' yelsǝniwagi, ki lǝge' atlu nǝ ta mboki toh tǝnki u.’
Iki i' hilya ɗǝ ge' atl ki Kaldiyawa, i' dǝm a Halam. Tyaka ɗaɗanu, kal ki mǝshti ki bwasi, i Lya bǝlti atlu nǝ nǝgun kini ki dǝmi alǝbi u.
Amma Lya a bǝlti, na' atl ko ki zi' asǝn wai aki, iki i Lya pǝlli' ndǝti ge' kalwasi tǝn bǝtlti atlisi ɗǝ gwasi, ge' cinisi amma Ibilahim yakǝn ni' ɗawai.
I Lya shilǝn nǝ Ibilahim: ‘Gǝswasi sǝn dǝmti sǝmbǝlsi ge' gatlu nǝ bǝ gwasǝn kǝn wai u, mbalǝn kige' gatli nǝn patlsi zheli as hwotisi bǝna hal hwon kutl cetl upsi.’
I Lya usu, ‘amma an hwoti atlu nǝ palkin zhelu u bezǝn lǝɓa,’ kalki nǝgu sǝn pe'ti ɗǝ ge' gatlu as nallǝn agelu u.’
Ta pǝli Ibilahim ndǝti ki sǝlkǝn. Nǝ Ibilahim zǝ' Ishayaku u mutti usǝpsi nǝ zǝ'ti is sǝlti. I Ishiyaku zǝ' Yakubu, i Yakubu zǝ mi'zǝ'mini kutl nǝ lopi.
“Mi'zǝ'miniyi ne, tǝngaki si dutugi nǝ Yusupu, is ulti taka, i talati Masal. Amma Lya nǝ ti,
i Lya pe'kǝlti ɗǝ ge' mus bǝnawasi. I' bǝl Yusupu ma'lǝɓa nǝ hwol hwula ma pil'auna Gu ki Masal. Ti Pil'auna ne i' palti mul gunti ki Masal, i kan mus mbalǝn ki libiwasi.
“Iki, i kuzǝn nde mus atl ki Masal nǝ Kan'ana, tǝngaki bezǝn bǝna u, hal mi'zǝ' mi'zǝ'mini is hol ulki ɗami.
Amma nǝ Yakubu kumi alkama ɗa a Masal u, lǝ'ki nǝn i' shin mi'zǝ' mi'zǝmini.
Ɗǝ lǝtwasǝn ki lop, i Yusupu ɓulisi gawasi ma' yelsǝnwasi, i Pil'auna man mbalǝn ki Yusupu.
Iki i Yusupu shinshinkǝn tǝn Yakubu bwasi tǝn mbǝ, nǝ mus yelsǝniwasi, mbalǝn kutl kutl lǝbi ningi nǝ namtam.
Iki i Yakubu lǝ Masal. Ti ne' mi'zǝ' mi'zǝmini a tya ka si mǝci.
Iki is yem hwun wasǝn te'ɗi is palsi tya Shekem, i la'si ge zǝɗi u nǝ Iblahim uli nǝ upki azulpa ama' mil ki Hamol aki a Shekem.
“Nǝ cin ɓalli Lya nja tǝ' ikǝni Iblahim pǝtl ndǝtwasu, dǝbǝtl ki mbalǝn nisi a Masal a mbǝltǝnkiyi iye.
I ki i pǝl pyal guu won a Masal, gunǝ bǝ'man wokǝn ki Yusupu wai u.’
Guu u ta tlǝ dlǝ' mbalǝnyinǝn i', ati hwoti' mi'zǝmini ishi ati la'tisi sǝ' la' hwal mil gunǝ zǝsi u taka.
“Age' muttisi sǝ zǝ Musa, yakǝni mbunini. Lii maki a ɗǝ ngaptiti a libi ɗǝ bwasi.
Nǝ zǝti a dla u, yakǝn ki Pil'auna yakǝnkǝli it kanti it kyetǝlti kǝni yakuwasi.
Iki i kulci Musa mus ma' lǝɓa ki Masalawa, ti kuma mul ndǝtl kǝni age' shilǝn nǝ kautǝnwasi.
“Nǝ Musa pǝl hwon kutl lǝbi upsi u, i' kǝndi a mbatlwasi tǝ le' ya mbalǝnwasi, Isla'ilawa.
Nǝ' eni si hwoti yelsewas ishu, iki illǝ ɗǝ dǝtlti i' li' mul masali im mǝci.
Musa ɗǝ ziti mbalǝnwas mani tu mati tǝ Lya pǝl kautǝn ki pekǝtlsi, amma sima niwai.
Lu cili nǝ Musa mbǝ ma'lu u nǝ mi' Isla'ilawa lop ɗǝ dlatu. Il lyami tǝ masi tǝn shitu ki ussu, ‘Kini mbalǝn kǝnǝmini yalaki ki lyap kumi' yelsǝni ciwo ɗa?’
“Amma mulnǝ kumi yelsewas ciwo u i' jakǝn Musa i' ussu, ‘Wokǝn laki ɗǝ gunti nǝ pǝtl shilǝn tǝnmi?
Lyamti kiɗa ki tloni kǝnǝ gunǝ tlo mulmasal a hwuɗwa?’
Nǝ Musa kumi nǝgu u, i' kitǝli ippǝl dǝpki sǝmbǝl tya Madayana, ge'lu u tǝ zǝ mil mwani lop.
Kalki hwon kutl kutl lǝbi upsi, i mul nje shinkǝn ki Lya mbǝ ma Musa ge bǝlǝn utu, ge dǝlgǝn nja nǝ zǝnga Sinai.
Nǝ Musa yen gu u, i' kum gagashinti nǝ unnǝ yeni u. Nǝ' sha'tya ɗǝ yati u, i' kum yalki Lya ɗǝ usu,
‘Ami ki Lya ki mul zǝ' mulzǝ' ki, Lya ki Iblahim nǝ Ishayaku nǝ Yakubu.’ Iki i dli ki Musa gop nyapti, ta pǝtl ndǝtl ki mbatl ki yatiwai.
Iki i' Lya ultisu, ‘Tus kapptilanwagi lu u nǝ kiɗa ki dlǝli u, lu mul gu'kǝni.
Balini, a en bezǝn lǝɓa u nǝ si pǝli' mbalǝn i'ni ki Masal u i, a kum kuluwasǝn i ki kup dli, a pe'sul lya i tǝngaki ta pekǝlsi. Nǝguni, mbǝ ta shinki tya Masal.’

“Ti Musa u nǝs ngetu asi ussu, ‘Okǝn laki ɗǝ mul kina inǝn nǝ mul pǝtl shilǝn?’ Ti Lya nǝ gawaskǝn shinti suɗi tǝ dǝm mul kina, nǝ mul pekǝtl mbalǝn, tuma' mul shikǝn ki Lya u nǝ mbǝ mati age dǝlgǝn ge' bǝlǝn utu.
Ti pekǝlsi ɗǝ Masal, kalki pǝtl ulki gagashinti nǝ lwaɗi a ge' atl ki Masal, nǝ ɗakǝshti gǝu dlǝlka, nǝ hwon kutl kutl lǝbi upsi a ge dǝlgǝn.
Guki Musa u nǝ ul Isla'ilawa usu, ‘Lya nǝn tlǝli'kin mul nje' shinkǝn ki Lya ge' yelsǝniwakǝn kǝni ami.’
Ti ne'kini u age dǝlgǝn, nǝ mul nje shinkǝn ki Lya u nǝ shilǝn nǝti, tǝn zǝnnga Sinai u, ne' mi'zǝ'mi'zǝ'mini ɗaɗanu. Ti kan shilǝn mul bǝtl mbatli summa Lya im mbǝlli mini.
“Amma mi'zǝmi'zǝmini nge bǝli'ti, is ngeti i mbatlwasǝn pal tya Masal.
Is ul Haluna usu, ‘Pǝlimi lya gunǝ tǝn ndemi kina u. Tǝn gaki Musa u, nǝ' pekǝlmi te' Masal u, mǝman unnǝ ndanǝtiwuwai.’
Age' cinisi iki is kǝn yakǝn tla. Is mbǝli' haɗaya is pǝl hwoltuki nǝ kautǝn u nǝs pǝli nǝ tohwasǝn u.
Tǝngaki nǝ gu i Lya bǝlsi kal, is zasi ɗǝ bǝtl cin nǝ lyi nǝ cadlǝl. Kan u nǝɗa ki laci ge' lwat bati ki mi'njeshinkǝn ki Lya u, i' usu,

content.text: “ ‘Kini Mbalǝn ki Isla'ila ami ki mbǝllinǝn haɗaya ki tlu ki ban hwon kutl kutl lǝbǝ upsi ge' dǝlgǝnya?
Ai, du'ni nǝ kǝs ki Molek nǝ lwa' cadlǝl ki Lapan,
lya unǝ pǝlini aki ngepti u.
Ami ne am patlkin tya kina ɗǝ Babila.’

content: “Mi'zǝmi'zǝmini si nǝ libi ki Lya amasi age' dǝlgǝn. Gunǝ pǝltli kan u nǝ Lya pi Musa u, kǝnǝ kan u nǝ' eni u.
Kal ki nje libi ki Lya, mi'zǝmi'zǝmini mbi is mbǝ nǝnali ge' atlu ge' hwon ki Joshuwa, kalki sa kan atlisi i mbalǝn ginǝ Lya katsi tǝn duwaɗǝnwasǝn u. Libi ki Lya u ɗa i mbǝl hwon ki Dawuda,
gunǝ mbi holhwula ma' Lya u i' gyemi tǝ pǝlli Lya ki Yakubu libi.
Amma Sulemanu kǝn kǝni' libi nisi.
Mus nǝ nǝgu mul nalti tǝn ɗa dǝp ge' libi i nǝ yakǝn mbalǝn kǝni nǝ tohwai. Kan u nǝ mul nje shikǝn ki Lya dlǝmi u:
Lya usu,

content.text: “ ‘Twa lya kǝn ki lu dǝptini ki guntini, a atl kǝn ki luzǝ' asǝn ini.
Unndi libi u kǝn ki kǝninǝni?
Ko kuma awu kǝn ki lushutini?
Ami nǝ gayikǝn a pǝl usi wai ya?’

content: “Kini mbalǝn mil ndǝtl ki ga, nǝ ndǝtl ki kǝm. Kǝnǝ mi'zǝmi'zǝkini kini ɗa: ko anǝmi ki pǝli Yal ki mbatl ki Lya natl ki ga.
Age' mi' nje shinkǝn ki Lya gukǝn mi'zǝmi'zǝkini a hwotisi bezǝn lǝbawai? Kuma is tlo ginǝ dlǝm shilǝn atǝn mbǝ ki mul ze' mbatlu, nǝ ngeti i tloti,
kini kamǝn zhil ma' mi' shinkǝn ki Lya, amma ka bǝliniwai.”
A la' Istipanus nǝ Zǝnga i
Nǝ mil dlǝl shilǝn kumi nǝgu u, is kum du tuki hal is ash bi ki hwoɗi tǝn gaki kup du tugi tǝnti.
Amma Istipanus, ki ikǝni nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ki gunti, i ut duwa ɗǝn twa lya, i' en natl ki Lya, a Yesu ki dlǝli tǝn toh shipti ki Lya.
I' usu, “Yanini, a en lya ki ɓuliyi yakǝn mbalǝn ki dlǝli atǝn tohship ki Lya.”
Amma is ca kǝmwasǝn, is tlǝl yali, is nde ga nǝ mbatl nǝm,
is pekǝlti tya kal gatli is gop lalati nǝ zǝnga. Kuma, mil enti nǝ dwaɗǝn is zi lulutuwasǝn ma yakǝn giɗǝn siwon shinwasi Shawulu.
Asi lalatiti nǝ zǝnga, a Istipanus ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya, “Mulban Yesu, kan mbadlini.”
Iki i' ngus nǝ ga hwulǝn i' tlil Yal nǝ dǝlti, i' usu, “Mul ban, bǝ zisi bezǝn lǝɓa u agawasǝnwai.” Nǝ usu nǝgu u, i' nde yenmbuɗi.
